ratios.covenant_name: maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio
ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement contains financial covenants requiring the Company to maintain a maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio of 5.25 to 1.00, which steps down to 4.25 to 1.00 over time, and a minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.00 to 1.00, in each case measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, with measurement to commence on the last day of the first full fiscal quarter after February 2, 2026.

The Credit Agreement contains financial covenants requiring the Company to maintain a maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio of 5.25 to 1.00, which steps down to 4.25 to 1.00 over time, and a minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.00 to 1.00, in each case measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, with measurement to commence on the last day of the first full fiscal quarter after February 2, 2026.

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual covenant ratios. It states only that the Company was in compliance with all financial covenants as of September 30, 2026. The maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio starts at 5.25x and steps down to 4.25x over time. The step-down schedule is not given, so the limit in force at 9/30/2026 is left null; it is likely between 5.25x and 4.25x. That maximum can be raised by 0.50x for qualifying material acquisitions. Ratios based on consolidated first lien net leverage only set interest margins and commitment fees, so they are excluded.
